groups.sentence: Users carefully evaluate an AI tool's capabilities and review institutional policies before using it.
Faculty and administrators adopt AI tools that meet trustworthiness criteria.
Staff consult department leadership and colleagues before choosing AI tools.
Instructors tell students which tools and resources are reliable sources of information.
Users choose AI tools from reputable, legitimate and trustworthy providers.
Users choose a tool designed for the task and consider whether AI is the most appropriate tool.
Users verify that a tool has adequate security and is appropriate for their data before using it.
Users review a tool's terms of service, privacy policies and data handling practices before using it.
Users research or critically evaluate a tool, including its reliability and bias, before choosing it.
Users are cautious of claims made by vendors and product providers.
Frameworks and guidance exist to help users evaluate and select AI tools.
